title: Nice little microwave
text: Nice little microwave. Nice little microwave.  Take note of it being only 900W  It takes a little longer to heat food, but it works great.  I received the camo, not sure why anyone would want camo, but if you have a camp and need a microwave, then this is the one for you.  It's not really hunter camo, but more like army camo.  Enjoy!

product_metadata.title: Farberware Classic FMO09BBTWDA 0.9-cu.ft. 900W Microwave Oven, Wood
features: With 0.9 Cubic Feet of cooking capacity and 900 Watts of output power, this compact countertop microwave delivers power, style, and convenience with a rustic Wood design to complement your kitchen
6 One-Touch cooking programs: Potato, Popcorn, Pizza, Beverage, Frozen Dinner, and Reheat. 1-6 minute Express Cook quick start controls allow you to heat up your favorite foods fast

Additional features such as +30-Seconds control button, Defrost by weight and time function, LED display with kitchen timer and clock, and Child Safety lock function make this a great choice for any kitchen
Multi-Stage cooking technology and a 10.6 inch turntable ensures even cooking for your favorite meal or snack

Exterior Product Dimensions- 19 x 14.51 x 10.95 inches (Length x Depth x Height); Interior Cavity Dimensions- 13.3 x 13.16 x 9.05 (Length x Depth x Height); Turntable Diameter- 10.6 inches; Voltage- 120V/60hz
description: The Farberware Classic Microwave delivers power, style, and convenience with a rustic Wood design that will complement your kitchen. This compact but mighty 0.9 Cubic Foot microwave oven offers 900 Watts of power and 10 power levels for versatile food prep. Features such as 1 to 6 minute Express Cook buttons, +30-Seconds control button, and Defrost Control by time or weight help you prepare your meal quickly and easily. 6 One-Touch cooking programs include: Potato, Popcorn, Pizza, Beverage, Frozen Dinner, and Reheat. Multi-Stage cooking function adjusts cooking level mid-cycle for perfect results without interruption. Additional features include an LED display with kitchen timer and clock as well as a child safety lock function to prevent accidental operation. The Farberware Classic is the perfect multi-tasker for your kitchen.
